analysis.json: data quality gate, per-stage client aggregates and the capacity model. Recomputable from the raw files by servtuner analyze.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/analysis.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5b46cdad0e5c`.

## Top level

| Field                 | Type                                                                   | Required | Description                                                                                    |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `analyzer_version`    | `string`                                                               | Yes      |                                                                                                |
| `hardware_profile_id` | `string`                                                               | No       | The hardware profile the results are scoped to; matches target-snapshot hardware\_profile\_id. |
| `quality`             | [runQuality](/reference/schemas/analysis/#runquality)                  | Yes      |                                                                                                |
| `stages`              | array of [stageAggregate](/reference/schemas/analysis/#stageaggregate) | Yes      |                                                                                                |
| `capacity`            | [capacityModel](/reference/schemas/analysis/#capacitymodel)            | Yes      |                                                                                                |

## Definitions

### qualityGrade

Type: `"good"`, `"degraded"`, `"unusable"`

### qualityIssueCode

The data quality checks.

Type: `"achieved_rps_low"`, `"send_lag_high"`, `"client_bound"`, `"target_saturated"`, `"target_stalled"`, `"low_resolution"`, `"config_drift"`, `"knob_mismatch"`, `"insufficient_samples"`, `"catalog_missing"`, `"series_gaps"`, `"knob_unverified"`, `"oom_restart"`, `"burst_stage"`, `"stream_batched"`

### qualityIssue

| Field     | Type                                                              | Required | Description |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `code`    | [qualityIssueCode](/reference/schemas/analysis/#qualityissuecode) | Yes      |             |
| `message` | `string`                                                          | Yes      |             |

### stageQuality

| Field             | Type                                                               | Required | Description                                                                              |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stage_index`     | `integer`                                                          | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                                      |
| `is_valid`        | `boolean`                                                          | Yes      | A trustworthy stage: achieved RPS, send lag and client\_bound are all within thresholds. |
| `is_client_bound` | `boolean`                                                          | Yes      |                                                                                          |
| `is_excluded`     | `boolean`                                                          | Yes      | True when the stage is left out of the capacity model.                                   |
| `issues`          | array of [qualityIssue](/reference/schemas/analysis/#qualityissue) | No       |                                                                                          |

### knobStatus

verified: the target's captured value equals the declared one. mismatch: it differs, so the change was not applied. unverified: the value cannot be captured.

Type: `"verified"`, `"mismatch"`, `"unverified"`

### knobCheck

| Field      | Type                                                  | Required | Description                                                       |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`     | `string`                                              | Yes      |                                                                   |
| `declared` | `string`                                              | Yes      | The RunSpec value, rendered as a string.                          |
| `actual`   | `string`                                              | No       | The captured value, rendered as a string; absent when unverified. |
| `status`   | [knobStatus](/reference/schemas/analysis/#knobstatus) | Yes      |                                                                   |

| Field          | Type                                                  | Required | Description |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |

| `is_collected` | `boolean`                                             | Yes      |             |

### coverage

### runQuality

### latencySummary

Percentiles with bootstrap confidence intervals; the value of each is in seconds.

| Field          | Type                                                              | Required | Description |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `mean_seconds` | `number`                                                          | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `max_seconds`  | `number`                                                          | No       | ≥ 0         |
| `p50_seconds`  | [bootstrapInterval](/reference/schemas/common/#bootstrapinterval) | Yes      |             |
| `p90_seconds`  | [bootstrapInterval](/reference/schemas/common/#bootstrapinterval) | Yes      |             |
| `p95_seconds`  | [bootstrapInterval](/reference/schemas/common/#bootstrapinterval) | Yes      |             |
| `p99_seconds`  | [bootstrapInterval](/reference/schemas/common/#bootstrapinterval) | Yes      |             |

### sloMaxRps

| Field                | Type                                          | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rps`                | `number`                                      | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `is_interpolated`    | `boolean`                                     | Yes      | True when rps lies between the valid stage and the failed one that brackets it; then failed\_stage\_index is required. failed\_stage\_index &gt; valid\_stage\_index is a servtuner analyze self-check. |
| `valid_stage_index`  | `integer`                                     | Yes      | Highest valid stage where every SLO holds. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                                          |
| `failed_stage_index` | `integer`                                     | No       | The bracketing stage that failed; absent when there is none. ≥ 0                                                                                                                                        |
| `limiting_slo`       | [sloName](/reference/schemas/common/#sloname) | No       | The SLO that failed at the bracketing stage.                                                                                                                                                            |

### kneeReason

Type: `"latency_slope"`, `"queueing"`, `"preemptions"`

### bottleneckResource

gpu\_util is the weak fallback when DCGM profiling metrics are missing.

Type: `"kv_cache"`, `"gpu_engine_activity"`, `"gpu_util"`, `"cpu"`, `"router_concurrency"`, `"upstream_capacity"`

### bottleneck

The resource closest to its ceiling at the knee.

| Field            | Type                                                                  | Required | Description                                                     |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `resource`       | [bottleneckResource](/reference/schemas/analysis/#bottleneckresource) | Yes      |                                                                 |
| `utilization`    | `number`                                                              | Yes      | How close to its ceiling the resource was at the knee. ≥ 0; ≤ 1 |
| `is_weak_signal` | `boolean`                                                             | Yes      |                                                                 |

### knee

Where headroom disappears. The bottleneck is judged here, so there is none without a knee.

| Field         | Type                                                  | Required | Description                                                                                      |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `stage_index` | `integer`                                             | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                                                              |
| `reason`      | [kneeReason](/reference/schemas/analysis/#kneereason) | Yes      |                                                                                                  |
| `slope_ratio` | `number`                                              | No       | For latency\_slope: how many times faster p95 latency grew than RPS; above 2 marks the knee. ≥ 0 |
| `bottleneck`  | [bottleneck](/reference/schemas/analysis/#bottleneck) | No       |                                                                                                  |

### perReplica

| Field             | Type      | Required | Description                                                 |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ready_replicas`  | `integer` | Yes      | The minimum number of replicas ready during the window. ≥ 1 |
| `rps_per_replica` | `number`  | Yes      | SLO-max RPS divided by ready\_replicas. ≥ 0                 |
| `total_gpus`      | `integer` | No       | GPUs across the ready replicas. ≥ 1                         |
| `rps_per_gpu`     | `number`  | No       | SLO-max RPS divided by total\_gpus. ≥ 0                     |

### capacityModel

Omitted members mean the run did not support the answer, for example no valid stage means no slo\_max.

| Field         | Type                                                  | Required | Description |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `slo_max`     | [sloMaxRps](/reference/schemas/analysis/#slomaxrps)   | No       |             |
| `knee`        | [knee](/reference/schemas/analysis/#knee)             | No       |             |
| `per_replica` | [perReplica](/reference/schemas/analysis/#perreplica) | No       |             |
